scenario.name: query-load-cpu
scenario.description: Task 2.5 (b), the CPU baseline for structured-query latency under ingest: closed-loop query clients at concurrency 1, 2, 4, 8 asking the demo questions, while ingest runs at 70% of the ramp-cpu rated capacity (2 cameras at 5 FPS = 10 frames/s, E-039), here 2 cameras at 3.5 FPS = 7 frames/s; same containerized services. The query service uses the canned planner (empty LLM_MODEL): zero cost, and the latency measured is everything except the LLM call, which a hosted model adds on top (p50 ~1.9 s, E-036). The ingest SLO is still judged at each step, so this also shows whether query load hurts freshness.
